name: Cueline

welcome: Cueline turns speech in your Premiere Pro sequence into captions on a caption track, with timing checked against the audio. Hebrew first, and 99 other languages.
It installs for your Windows account only. No administrator rights needed.
Nothing is uploaded: it runs on this computer.
results: Downloaded ivrit.ai large-v3-turbo, Speaker and silence models
next: Open the panel: Window > Extensions > Cueline.
Pick a sequence and click Transcribe.
preview.keep: Next, Cueline is updated. Your speech models, settings and history are kept.
preview.removes: Removes the Adobe® Premiere Pro® panel and its engine.
preview.removeAll: Also remove the speech models, settings and history
preview.unconfirm: Cueline will be removed from Premiere Pro. Your speech models, settings and history (in %APPDATA%\Cueline) are kept, unless you chose to remove them too.
